# Fresh Frozen Plasma (FFP)

**Authors:** Hina Khawar, Preeti Patel, Joshua B. Stevens, Nilmarie Guzman

**Source:** StatPearls - StatPearls Publishing

## Abstract

Fresh-frozen plasma (FFP) administration is indicated for patients with coagulation factor deficiencies, abnormal coagulation test results, and active bleeding. This intervention is also used to optimize coagulation parameters in patients with coagulation abnormalities about to undergo an invasive procedure or reverse warfarin's effects in the presence of active bleeding or insufficient response to vitamin K before a planned procedure. Additional indications include thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura and congenital or acquired factor deficiencies when no alternative therapy is available.
